sources.title: Dual-Use Foundation Models with Widely Available Model Weights Report
sources.snippet: Dual-use foundation models with widely available model weights (referred to in this Report as open foundation models) introduce a wide spectrum of benefits. They diversify and expand the array of actors, including less resourced actors, that participate in AI research and development.
